{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Number of patients with multiple rows
num_duplicate_patients = len(duplicate_patients)

# Show the highest sample_seq for each patient
max_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_deduped = df.loc[df.set_index('patient_id')['sample_seq'].isin(max_sample_seq)]

# Verify: number of rows after deduplication
num_rows_after_dedup = len(df_deduped)

# Print results
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {num_duplicate_patients}")
print(f"Number of rows after deduplication: {num_rows_after_dedup}")

# Return the deduplicated DataFrame for further use
df_deduped"}
